Sexy nun: Geeh! Priestcan woke up! 
Holy shit! It really looks like some sort of walking ATM. 
Priestcan: Actually, my name is Ecclesiasticalot FF and I’m a priest in this parish.
Sexy nun: And? No one can even pronounce it right so why even bother saying it!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: My name was given by John Paul 202 and changing it would be a great sin. 
…
At Least this bot took her attention from me. 
Sexy nun: Whatever you say. So, why did you come here? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I was updating my database in peace, but then my sensors picked out loud noises in the nave. I thought some problematic people came, but it’s just you again. 
Sexy nun: As you can see, nothing serious is happening. Go back to sleep. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
Ecclesiasticalot FF: There’s someone new with you. Your friend?
Sexy nun: Not really. We only talked a little. Argue actually.
Ouch.
I guess I will introduce myself. 
You: Hi. My name is Anon. 
Sexy nun: Oh, right. I almost forgot. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceNormal
Sexy nun: I’m Shanice. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I believe I already introduced myself earlier. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: So. Why did you come here?
You: Yeah…{{wi}} I’m actually a little bit religious and there is this new pope from what I read in the news, so I came to check things out, you know?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes, there is a new pope, sadly I don’t know a lot of things about him yet, because I needed to cancel my update to come here to talk to you.
You: Sorry about that.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: As you know now I can't quench your thirst for knowledge. I recommend coming here another day. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceSerious
'Nun' Shanice: Huh? Are you kicking us out?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: No, I’m not.
'Nun' Shanice: It sure sounds like you want us gone. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Time you came here is a bit misfortunate, yes, but my program forbids me to remove someone from church for such reasons. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceHappy
'Nun' Shanice: You hear him, Anon? Priestcan isn’t really a nice person lol. Good thing someone put brakes on his rudeness. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m not rude. I would even say that I’m quite forgiving. I even annulled your fines last month. 
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry
'Nun' Shanice: You were the one who put them on me in the first place! Ugh! I can’t forget this humiliation!
You: What is this all about?
'Nun' Shanice: This jerk ratted me out in my college! When the rector, a believing white male, heard about this he said he will expel me if I don’t pay it all up!
You: That kinda sucks, but what did you do?

'Nun' Shanice: …
Ecclesiasticalot FF: She crossdressed as a priest and tried to…
#Nun.Face.nunFaceAngry

I…{{wi}} I don’t think I want to know what she did.
